newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks extend gains as high-tech shares up.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks extend gains as high-tech shares up.

text.p: Taiwan share prices extended gains in late Wednesday trade on active buying of high-technology stocks, brokers said.
At 0325 GMT, with 35 minutes to go, the index had risen 111.38 points or 1.34 percent to 8,405.65. Turover was T$82 billion.

"After recent consolidation, the outlook of high-technology shares still looks bright," said Tsao Chung-ping, a manager of Ting Kong Securities. United Micro was up T$3.5 or 5.3 percent to T$69.5. But brokers warned quick profit-taking may soon emerge. -- Alice Hung (2-5080815)
